statements.classic: For solo and technical founders who are tired of being their business's only heartbeat, Cambium is a venture operator that keeps the business alive, on-mission and solvent while they step away. Unlike autonomous 'AI runs your company' tools that chase task throughput, Cambium holds every venture inside its viability bounds, gates every irreversible move, and records every decision so it can be replayed.
statements.one_sentence: Cambium is the patient operator above your AI agents that keeps your business in the game — solvent, on-mission and advancing — even when you step away.
statements.core: Keep your business in the game: an always-on operator that protects viability first, moves only on real evidence, and shows its work.

headlines.primary: Your business, still alive tomorrow — even when you step away.
headlines.subheadline: Cambium is the patient operator above your AI agents: it keeps you solvent and on-mission, asks before anything irreversible, and logs every move.
headlines.proof_point: Solvency is a hard bound, every paid or irreversible move fails closed, and every decision is replayable.

differentiators: Optimizes time-in-game (viability margin), not task throughput
Solvency is a hard bound; revenue is a regulated output
Fail-closed gate on irreversible and paid moves
Brand/mission setpoint moves only on real customer evidence
Replayable decision log with honest claim labels

primary.value: Living continuity — the business stays in the game
